name: assay-relational-discord
description: Science calibration and qualified discrepancy analysis across typed laws, measured carriers, FOUR evidence and receiver contracts, using the owning Obsmetrologia and domain assays.
preconditions: an existing authorized Science allocation or work obligation and its receiver are identified
the owning law, version, expected relation, tolerance and admissible evidence are resolved or remain explicitly unknown
observations retain provenance and are not conflated with proof or operational receiving
postconditions: the comparison either qualifies a falsifiable obligation or records the exact missing premise/evidence, without declaring lawful differences defects
local versus composed discord and independent causal witnesses are distinguished
the existing work holds a scoped Engineering handoff with golden vectors or a named open Science derivation

records: owning standard, baseline and typed contract identity
admitted source evidence or retained epistemic uncertainty, counterexample and assay method
receiving Science judgement and downstream Engineering contract when qualified
